title: KestrelCare Claims Review Q&A: Repeat Diagnosis on the Same System
content:
**Rule.** On a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts repair order, a repeat-diagnosis share applies to the diagnostic hours, counted from the plan's approved decisions on the same vehicle system before this repair order: where one was decided within the last three months the hours are paid at the short repeat-diagnosis share of 50 percent; where one was decided within the last twelve months but none within three months they are paid at the long repeat-diagnosis share of 75 percent; otherwise they are paid in full.

**Which decisions count?** The claim decision entries on the plan's history with decision approved, on the same vehicle system as the decision being paid, other than that decision itself. Denials do not count. The three-month and twelve-month periods are counted back from the day of the payment.

**Where does the share apply?** Last, to the diagnostic hours, immediately before they are multiplied by the hourly rate.

**An earlier approved electrical decision five months ago, none since — what share?** 75 percent.

| Earlier approved decisions on the same system | Hours paid |
|---|---|
| at least one in the last three months | 50 percent |
| none in three months, at least one in twelve | 75 percent |
| none in twelve months | 100 percent |

*Hypothetical:* 3.0 hours with an earlier approved decision on the same system six weeks before are paid as 1.5 hours.
